name: Thai Airways

strictness.note: Existing type/region prior, not a researched enforcement rating.

allowances.note: Thai Airways states that the dimensions include wheels, handles and side pockets.
Free item described as a handbag, wallet, purse, notebook or portable personal computer.
For international travel commencing on or after 2 March 2026. Standard receives one 23 kg piece; Full Flex and Flexi receive two. Each bag is limited to 158 cm including wheels and handles.

research_scope: Standard adult Economy cabin and personal item allowances plus the current international Economy Standard checked allowance.
audit_note: Official carry-on and checked-baggage pages read directly. Checked entitlements vary by fare, class and route; only the international Economy Standard row is active here. Enforcement and physical sizer dimensions remain unresearched.
